summary: Pat Bush, 66, of Pittsburgh (recently retired from U.S. Steel), was ejected from a commercial raft and died during a rafting trip on the Eagle River near Vail; he was rafting with his wife Lois, two other rafters and one raft guide; the raft did not flip and the other four stayed in the boat.
